subject: Planning: Dedicated inference topology — runbook, isolation, autoscale (time-sync)

Subject: Quick ask — deep dive on dedicated inference topology

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro last week. HelioTech is ramping a production inference workload and we want to schedule a technical deep-dive focused on dedicated GPU topology: pool sizing, autoscale behavior under burst, and isolation strategies (multi-tenant safety + noisy-neighbor mitigation).

We have a short list of requirements and traffic profiles (attached) — would appreciate a 60–90 minute architecture session with your infra/ops folks to walk through runbook-level decisions and fallback strategies.

Suggested windows next week (PST):
- Tue 8/3 10:00–11:30
- Wed 8/4 14:00–15:30
- Thu 8/5 09:00–10:30

Attendees from our side: Sam Reynolds (infra lead), Priya Khatri (SRE), and a procurement observer.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join (runtime, capacity ops, solutions)? Also please send any pre-reads so we can make the session tactical.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Reynolds
Head of Infrastructure, HelioTech

Hi Sam — great to hear HelioTech is moving into production.

We can cover runtime kernel selection, autoscaler behavior under varied sequence-lengths, and practical isolation patterns (pools + evict/soft-isolate strategies). For the runbook-level conversation we'll have:
- Karthik (Capacity/Autoscale)
- Marissa (Solutions + runbook author)
- Me (Customer technical lead)

I attached a rough topology diagram and your traffic CSV to this thread (proposed-topology-diagram.pdf, heliotech-q3-traffic-profiles.csv). That should help Karthik size the pool in advance.

From your proposed windows, Wed 8/4 14:00–15:30 PST works best for us — I'll tentatively book 90 minutes. If HelioTech prefers a tighter timebox, Marissa suggests focusing to 60 minutes and using a follow-up breakout.

Before the call, can you: 
- Confirm whether you need multi-tenant isolation across business units or strict customer-per-tenant isolation (affects eviction policies).
- Share any SLOs (p50/p95 target latencies) and expected sustained qps per model.

I'll send a calendar invite with objectives and a short pre-read (1 page) from our runbook.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
